records.label: Linear functions and models

records.label: Exponential growth or decay

records.label: Definite integrals and area

fields: Can you present and reference the key data, tables and diagrams without copying an enormous dataset or doing excessive manual formatting?
If the proposed dataset or outputs are large/complex

fields: What other IA topic could you investigate? (Up to two additional ideas.)

fields: Which idea is most useful/interesting and realistic given your time?

fields: Which idea would you like to plan now?

fields: What other realistic method of collecting or finding this data did you consider?

fields: What is the main limitation of your chosen collection/source method?

fields: What population and sampling method will you use? What alternative was possible?

fields: What initial-idea, teacher-draft and final deadlines has your school set?

fields: When could you complete an initial calculation and reflect on it?

fields: What result or difficulty might cause you to change the direction of your investigation?

fields: Do you expect a roughly linear positive relationship?

records.label: Do you expect a roughly linear negative relationship?
fields: Do you expect a roughly linear negative relationship?
Scatter plots and Pearson's r; Linear regression
Planning only: a negative relation is one possibility, not an observed result. Check the ACTUAL scatter first; interpret correlation and method-specific limitations only if subsequently used.

fields: Do you expect distinct clusters or more than one peak?

fields: Might the groups differ more in spread than in mean?

fields: Do you expect the count of successes to follow a binomial distribution?
